segments.an4.220:1.1: “Catūhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
segments.an4.220:1.3: Assaddho hoti, dussīlo hoti, kusīto hoti, duppañño hoti – imehi kho, bhikkhave, catūhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
segments.an4.220:2.1: “Catūhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge.
segments.an4.220:2.3: Saddho hoti, sīlavā hoti, āraddhavīriyo hoti, paññavā hoti – imehi kho, bhikkhave, catūhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge”ti.
segments.an4.220:3.1: Parisā diṭṭhi akataññutā, pāṇātipātāpi dve maggā;
segments.an4.220:3.3: Dve vohārapathā vuttā, ahirikaṃ duppaññena cāti.
